content.overview: It is not incompatible with an arbitration agreement for the tribunal to encourage settlement. If the parties settle during proceedings, the tribunal shall terminate the proceedings and, if requested by the parties and not objected to by the tribunal, record the settlement in the form of an arbitral award on agreed terms. An award on agreed terms has the same status and effect as any other award on the substance of the dispute.
content.glance: Tribunal may encourage settlement; settlement can be recorded as an award on agreed terms with full award status.
content.study: Encouraging settlement is compatible with arbitration. On settlement, proceedings terminate. At the parties' request and without tribunal objection, the settlement may be recorded as an award on agreed terms with the same status as any other award.
